This included organizing MCC workstreams, introducing planning and tracking systems, launching MCC Open Office Hours, coordinating the development of onboarding resources such as the Start Here document, and overseeing work on membership engagement initiatives. We’ve primarily been focused on onboarding and building the foundation for the work ahead.

As a newly elected MCC, I officially started my role on May 5th, 2026. During this first period, I actively participated in both MCC internal biweekly calls, as well as the onboarding call organized for new MCC members.
I also focused on familiarizing myself with the MCC workflow, communication channels, and collaboration tools, including Discord, ClickUp, and the MCC workstream Miro board. 
This initial phase allowed me to better understand the MCC structure, processes, and responsibilities in
Participated in all onboarding sessions. Getting familiar with all the docs.

May was a transition period with the formation of the new committee. My contributions this month focused on the allocation of new responsibilities among committee members, attending meetings, and participating in discussions regarding program needs throughout the year.

I also attended several meetings with Intersect to discuss the draft responsibilities and budget for the Hub. In addition, I continued maintaining the Indonesia Hub, with the goal of introducing and promoting Cardano.

This was my first month as a CBC member, during which I participated in weekly meetings and working sessions. Key activities included discussions on the live budget process and voting on statements released by the CBC to the public.
We also began working on matters related to the allocation and distribution of funds from the Cardano Treasury. In addition, we conducted research and data verification on several entities and individual proposers whose names may have changed, based on Catalyst data.
Active participation in meetings and pre meeting preparation and support, sync with GMC

For this period, I joined the Open Source Committee after my election in April 2026 and started in May 2026. My contributions focused on onboarding, including participation in the onboarding call and bi-weekly OSC internal calls to understand ongoing activities and priorities. 

I also familiarized myself with collaboration tools and processes such as Discord, ClickUp, and shared documentation systems to integrate effectively into the team workflow.

My May month contribution focused on setting up the Governance Participation Incentive working group. This work included tasks like documentation, weekly meetings and voting, research and discussion around governance incentivisation.

I also contributed to the Civics Committee by attending all weekly meetings and actively engaging in the discussion both synchronously and asynchronously. I voted in meetings to see to the progression of the CAP working group and the GPI working group.
Participate in MCC meetings by sharing my experience with new elected members. And I've got new terms to translate into french from the Intersect site...
